results.rationale: Consistency: column positions and proportions shift slightly, and the gray background becomes white. Instruction: eight columns remain instead of the requested five; the count change is absent. Quality: the edited columns have coherent fluting, bases, perspective and shading without visible structural artifacts.

Consistency: the wooden pushpins and their scattered arrangement are entirely replaced by hands. Instruction: six fingernails are shown, but the source metal-pointed pins were the objects to reduce to six; the request is misinterpreted. Quality: the visible fingers, glossy nails, skin texture and lighting are coherent and natural.
